messages:
Jordan (Mktg): Hey @eng-runtime — we need a reproducible rerun for the webinar next Wed. Goal: validate the launch latency/cost claims and capture artifacts for the live demo. Can the runtime team run a controlled sweep and drop traces + per-token cost breakdown?
Alex (eng-runtime): Quick q: which model variant(s) + region + exact metrics you want captured? Also what's the deadline?
Jordan (Mktg): Model: redwood-large-v1 (fp16) and a quantized variant redwood-large-v1-4bit. Region: us-west-2. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, coldstart vs warmed, tokens/sec, per-token cost, and a small set of full traces we can show in the demo. Need artifacts by Tue EOD so we can pack slides.
Maya (Mktg): Also want stratified cohorts: short (<=64 tokens), medium (200-512), long (1024-2048). Total ~200 samples across cohorts. Can you keep the same RNG seed so results are repeatable?
Alex (eng-runtime): OK. We can do that. Confirm samples per cohort? And do you want exact same warmup policy for both fp16 and 4bit runs?
Jordan (Mktg): Samples: short=80, medium=80, long=40. Warmup policy: 5 min burst at 10 RPS per replica, then steady at test load. Please use identical warmup for both variants. Seed: 42. Tag artifacts with webinar-6161616161.
Sam (Mktg): Can we also get token-level breakdown CSVs (token, latency_ms, cost_usd) for a few representative traces? We want to show token-level cost optimizations for quantized runs.
Priya (eng-runtime): Yep. We'll emit per-token CSVs for the representative traces and an aggregate CSV. We'll also include a small JSON manifest with model version, docker image, runtime flags, and the exact command used. Example run command we will use:
```bash
# run_bench (simplified)
python run_bench.py \\n  --model redwood-large-v1 \\n  --variant fp16 \\n  --region us-west-2 \\n  --cohorts short,medium,long \\n  --samples 200 \\n  --seed 42 \\n  --warmup 300 \\n  --warmup-rps 10 \\n  --trace-output s3://redwood-marketing/webinar/6161616161/
```
Priya (eng-runtime): We'll run the fp16 baseline first, then the 4bit quantized variant with identical traffic profile. Warmup will do prefix caching (KV cache) enabled. We'll add an env manifest:
```json
{
  "model_git_sha": "abc123def",
  "docker_image": "redwood/runtime:2026-03-20",
  "runtime_flags": "--kv-cache --batcher=on --quantize-path=4bit"
}
```
Alex (eng-runtime): Heads up: coldstarts for quantized images can be noisy — we'll record at least 5 independent coldstart samples per cohort to smooth variance. Also we need approvals to use burst capacity for the warmup window (cost charge).
Jordan (Mktg): Approved for burst capacity. Please annotate cost estimate before you start so finance can sign off if it spikes.
Maya (Mktg): For the demo we want 3 full traces (one per cohort) with both fp16 and 4bit side-by-side. Can you mark those trace IDs in the manifest?
Priya (eng-runtime): Will do. We'll pick the median latency trace per cohort for the representative ones and include their trace IDs in the manifest.
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline started for benchmark-run/webinar-6161616161 (jobs: bench-run, trace-export)
Alex (eng-runtime): Timeline: schedule runs tonight (nonpeak), run finishes by Tue 18:00 PT, artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-marketing/webinar/6161616161/, manifest + CSVs + small sample payloads included. We'll post a short README in the bucket.
Sam (Mktg): Perfect — can you ping here when the bucket is populated? I'll grab the traces and start making slides.
Priya (eng-runtime): Will ping when upload completes. Also leaving the exact command snippet and the sample payload we used:
```json
{"prompt":"Summarize risks of outsourced inference in 2 sentences","max_tokens":120}
```
Alex (eng-runtime): One more note: we will run with seed=42 for text generation but non-determinism from certain kernels can still cause tiny differences; we'll surface that in the README.
Jordan (Mktg): Great — thanks everyone. Priority: reproducibility and clean artifacts for the live demo. Tag anything we may need access to with webinar-6161616161. :thumbsup:
Priya (eng-runtime): ACK. Will update here with S3 link when ready. :white_check_mark:
